context: Generic validation failures blocked targeted correction; live feedback loop now rejects invalid references then criterion inventory and stops at its configured limit.
decision: Use fixed diagnostics bound to original input evidence and prior failed attempt; charge every isolated call and stop on budgets, timeout or identity drift. Never silently promote hypotheses or relax source invariants.
